The '''Barkhesh system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Seitia sector/Legends|Seitia sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barkhesh/Legends|Barkhesh]].
